facts.fact: 清晨 Anya 到场、Darragh 进屋要送 Cora 去上课时，Rory 只穿刚过大腿中部的短束衣和内裤；Darragh 立即转身背对回避，事后道歉称错在自己而非 Cora，Rory 则让他当着 Anya 的面直呼自己 Rory。
facts.anchor: I realized a moment too late that I was wearing nothing but a tunic that barely grazed mid-thigh and panties.

facts.fact: Gabriel 的第一封信（署名「Your favorite seraph, Gabriel」）：追剿民兵篡位者已重回正轨、盼早日回来，还想再偷一个吻；Rory 当着 Anya 翻了白眼，抱怨与 Gabriel 相处从没超过两天。
facts.anchor: I apologize for being so absent. We are set back on course to find those horrid militia usurpers, and I hope that I am back to you soon.

facts.fact: Anya 解释 Gabriel 的底细：全王国头号黄金单身汉、angheal 视他只比国王低一等；Rory 进宫后他喝止贵妇纠缠、不从者送去 atoner；Anya 还握有许多贵妇的秘密，可要挟她们守规矩。
facts.anchor: Before you came to the castle, ladies practically threw themselves at him, the kingdom’s most eligible bachelor. Once you came here, he made it clear that they needed to stop immediately, and if they didn’t, he would send them to the atoner.

facts.fact: 国王 Torrish 的第二封信下最后通牒：学者汇报 Rory 拒不回答且未按承诺回去，限她当天去图书馆见学者答问，否则撤回对她们母女的庇护；Rory 吓得脸色发白，Anya 安抚说照国王命令去做就没事。
facts.anchor: My scholars notified me that you were unwilling to answer any of their questions and have not returned as promised to do so. You will go to the library today to meet with the scholars and answer all their questions.

facts.fact: 图书馆盘问前 Acrion 骂 Darragh 是 crossling、喝令他在外等候；Darragh 低吼拒绝，Rory 挡到两人中间、以「国王兄弟命令队长不得离开她视线」反将一军，白眼学者 Epicuro 松口放行，Acrion 附加条件是 Darragh 不许出一声。
facts.anchor: “You don’t have a say in the matter, crossling,” Acrion sneered. “We cannot efficiently interview her with you lurking about, intimidating us, and trying to challenge our word at every turn.

facts.fact: 三位学者（Acrion、白眼的 Epicuro、严苛如牧师的 Zeno）盘问约一小时：Rory 报出家乡 Tellisonuh City、贵族出身、父母名 Eliza 与 Fionn Alwine、无兄弟姐妹；被问人类长处她答「创造力与适应力」、短处答「阶级、不平等与偏见」；Darragh 在桌下轻抚她的手臂帮她稳住。
facts.anchor: “Eliza and Fionn Alwine.” At the mention of my parents, my leg started bouncing up and down under the large table. Darragh lightly brushed my arm with his hand, unseen to the scholars.

facts.fact: 盘问后 Darragh 骑马带 Rory 到城边树林密谈：他驻西谷 threshing wall 的线人只听说有人类短暂现身、从未亲见；还有线人说大陆西侧风里时常传来成群人声、前去查看却毫无异常；两人都觉得这次盘问反常——不问穿墙经过、只追问她本不该懂的军事。
facts.anchor: I spoke with a few of my own contacts who are stationed out by the threshing wall in the west valley. They all said that they have heard rumors of humans being seen briefly, but they haven’t seen any themselves.

facts.fact: Rory 突然想到 Edenalee 十多年来失踪人口持续上升、可能都是被 seraph 带来这里——她自己失踪的父亲和 Cora 的父亲 Micah 也是如此；Micah 留下的字条只写着他爱她，她开始怀疑他并非自愿离开。
facts.anchor: “What if the numerous missing people of Edenalee over the years could have been brought here by seraphs?”

facts.fact: 密谈收尾：Rory 决定把「人类疑被 seraph 带来」的怀疑暂只与 Darragh 两人保守、不告诉 Gabriel；Darragh 承诺动用一切力量查清真相、称她与自己在一起是安全的，并重申按约当晚教她防身。
facts.anchor: He turned and faced me. “I promised I would this evening. I am a man of my word.”
